analysis: Only CHANGELOG.md (head lines 599-1030) was supplied; both units are documentation text with no code, configuration, or authorization logic. They describe App Attest dead-key rotation, rotation budgets (1/hour, 4/24h, EIGENINFERENCE_APP_ATTEST_KEY_ROTATION_PERCENT default 100), invalidKey enrollment backoff, APNs code-identity retry, DeviceCheck diagnostics, release qualification, and legacy MDM/App Attest coexistence. The changelog claims rotations never revoke or deny serving and that the new key must pass full attestation, receipt, build-qualification and assertion checks. It also says diagnostics are untrusted and outside the signed transcript. These claims are consistent with TB-002/TB-009/TB-011 and T-052..T-058 as described, but the actual code was not supplied, so enforcement cannot be verified from this change. The next pass should check rotation admission locking, machine-merge budget carry-over, and whether a fresh attestation request path can be abused to dodge the budget or strand providers (T-057). It should also confirm that diagnostics fields (launch_session, boot_time, operation_stalled_seconds) remain excluded from the authorization and signed-transcript decisions (T-056/T-058), and that APNs retry stays within the per-device push budget. No concrete security regression, new attack surface, or invalidated assumption is evident from this documentation-only diff.
